# A Go package may pass a region to a callee, and every
# region_escape-shaped use falls back to the heap with a diagnostic,
# never a correctness::region_escape error.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena,logosescape

cd m
go build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'p\.go:7:.*placed in region'
stderr 'p\.go:21:.*region fallback'
stderr 'p\.go:28:.*region fallback'
stderr 'p\.go:35:.*region fallback'
stderr 'p\.go:46:.*region fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'
! stderr 'perf::'
! stderr 'correctness::'
! stderr '\[[a-z]+::'

cd ../run
go run -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:14:.*placed in region'
stderr 'main\.go:28:.*region fallback'
stderr 'main\.go:36:.*region fallback'
stderr 'main\.go:44:.*region fallback'
stderr 'main\.go:54:.*region fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'
! stderr 'perf::'
! stderr 'correctness::'
! stderr '\[[a-z]+::'
stdout '^1$'
stdout '^9$'
stdout '^5$'
-- run/go.mod --
module example.com/regiongocasesrun

go 1.27

-- run/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

var saved *int
var savedFn func()

//go:noinline
func use(r arena.Region) int {
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 1
	return *p
}

func callCallee() int {
	r := arena.Open()
	n := use(r)
	_ = r
	return n
}

func returnIt() *int {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 9
	_ = r
	return p
}

func sendIt(ch chan *int) {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 5
	ch <- p
	_ = r
}

func goIt(done chan int) {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 7
	go func() {
		_ = *p
		done <- 1
	}()
	_ = r
}

func cloHandle() {
	r := arena.Open()
	f := func() { _ = r }
	savedFn = f
	_ = r
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(callCallee())
	saved = returnIt()
	fmt.Println(*saved)
	ch := make(chan *int, 1)
	sendIt(ch)
	fmt.Println(*<-ch)
	done := make(chan int, 1)
	goIt(done)
	<-done
	cloHandle()
	savedFn()
}
-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/regiongocases

go 1.27

-- m/p.go --
package p

import "logos/arena"

//go:noinline
func use(r arena.Region) int {
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 1
	return *p
}

func CallCallee() int {
	r := arena.Open()
	n := use(r)
	_ = r
	return n
}

func ReturnIt() *int {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	_ = r
	return p
}

func SendIt(ch chan *int) {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	ch <- p
	_ = r
}

func GoIt(done chan int) {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	go func() {
		_ = *p
		done <- 1
	}()
	_ = r
}

var sinkFn func()

func CloHandle() {
	r := arena.Open()
	f := func() { _ = r }
	sinkFn = f
	_ = r
}
